tasks.title: Phone number
tasks.statement: Write a function is_phone(s): True if the whole string is a number like «+7-900-123-45-67» (after +7 come four groups separated by hyphens: 3, 3, 2 and 2 digits). Use re.fullmatch.

tasks.title: Numbers from text
tasks.statement: Write a function find_numbers(text): a list of all integers in the text, as int; a number may be preceded by a minus.

tasks.title: Email addresses
tasks.statement: Write a function extract_emails(text): a list of addresses of the form name@domain.zone (Latin letters, digits, dots and underscores in the name and domain), in order of appearance.

tasks.title: Extra spaces
tasks.statement: Write a function collapse_spaces(text): replace each run of whitespace characters (spaces, tabs, newlines) with a single space and strip the spaces at the edges.

tasks.title: Parsing a date
tasks.statement: Write a function parse_date(s): from a string «DD.MM.YYYY» return a tuple of numbers (year, month, day). If the whole string does not match the format, return None.
tasks.hint: m = re.fullmatch(r"(\d\d)\.(\d\d)\.(\d{4})", s); if m: int(m[3]), int(m[2]), int(m[1]).

tasks.title: Hashtags
tasks.statement: Write a function hashtags(text): a list of hashtags (a word after #: letters, digits and underscores) without the # character, in lowercase.

tasks.title: Words without punctuation
tasks.statement: Write a function split_words(text): a list of the words of the text (letters and digits), without punctuation and without empty items. Use re.findall.

tasks.title: Censorship
tasks.statement: Write a function censor(text, bad): replace each word from the list bad (whole words only, case-insensitive) with «***». Do not touch parts of other words: «cat» must not spoil «catalog».
tasks.hint: Build the pattern r"\b(?:" + "|".join(map(re.escape, bad)) + r")\b" and call re.sub with the re.I flag.

tasks.title: Log line to a dictionary
tasks.statement: Write a function parse_log(line): the string «2024-03-05 09:07:03 ERROR disk failure» becomes a dictionary with the keys "date", "time", "level" and "msg". If the string does not fit, return None. Use named groups.
